page.overview:
What is Shakky's Rip-off Bar?

The Shakky's Rip-off Bar is a bar at Grove 13 of Sabaody Archipelago, and is run by Shakuyaku. It was originally founded on the Pirate Island Hachinosu in the New World.

It is infamous for its high prices (hence the name Rip-Off Bar), and Shakky's practice of beating up customers who refuse to pay. It is also where Silvers Rayleigh can often be found, as he frequents the bar whenever he is not out doing other activities, such as gambling.

During her time in Hachinosu, she had a policy that customers were not allowed to fight in the bar. Also, it was one of the very few, if not only, places in Hachinosu that is actually peaceful thanks to her beauty and charm. Although she served inferior quality food and beverages for high prices (once again, hence the name "Rip-Off"), none of the customers cared due to being charmed by her beauty.

After retiring as captain of the Kuja Pirates 42 years ago, Shakuyaku settled down on Hachinosu and opened up Shakky's Rip-off Bar, attracting a huge number of clientele including several members of the Rocks Pirates leading to a month-long waiting list for entry. Eventually the bar was relocated to the Sabaody Archipelago.
